description: Read one SEC Form D securities offering notice (or D/A amendment) by its ACCESSION NUMBER, e.g. "0001603198-14-000001", with or without the issuer CIK: offering amounts (total offered, amount sold, remaining), investors already invested, first sale, exemptions claimed (Rule 506(b)/506(c), Investment Company Act 3(c)(1)/3(c)(7)), securities offered, issuer identity, executives/related persons, commissions and finders' fees, and exact SEC provenance. Prefer this over the generic EDGAR filing readers whenever the accession is a Form D: it parses the structured notice rather than searching rendered text. Only have the issuer's name? Use form_d_search_issuers.
name: form_d_offering_detail
title: Form D Offering Detail
